bug_fix_verification.bug_description: When parent SG is partially in stock, child MOs were being created with full BOM requirement (child_qty) instead of shortage quantity. E.g., if SG1 needs 5 but has 3 in stock (shortage=2), its children SG1a (BOM qty=2) and SG1b (BOM qty=3) were getting MOs for 10 and 15 respectively instead of 4 and 6.
bug_fix_verification.fix_description: Changed recursive call from create_child_work_orders(child_item_id, child_qty, ...) to create_child_work_orders(child_item_id, shortage_qty, ...). Now child MOs are correctly sized to the parent's shortage, not the full BOM requirement.
bug_fix_verification.verification_result: CONFIRMED WORKING - Scenario B test proves child MOs (SG1a=4, SG1b=6) are scaled to parent shortage (2), not full qty (5)
